packageRules.description: Group all Actions bumps (github-actions manager also covers .forgejo/workflows) into one PR.

nginx + supervisor are pinned in the Dockerfile and tracked via the custom `debian-madison` datasource (markers there): Debian QA's madison service (UDD-backed), one text line per suite, restricted to trixie + trixie-updates + trixie-security, i.e. exactly what apt inside the image can install. Why not the obvious choices: Repology strips the Debian -N+debNNuM revision so it can't see security rebuilds; Renovate's built-in `deb` datasource hard-codes Packages.gz but debian-security only publishes Packages.xz (renovatebot/renovate#44330, PR #35865 unmerged), so its trixie-security registry 404s and is skipped at DEBUG level — it never saw deb13u8/u9 and CI was red for a month (2026-09-16 → 2026-10-11). All apt bumps grouped into one PR.

Exempt the Debian apt pins from the global 3-day minimumReleaseAge. Two reasons: the debian-apt group's whole point is picking up trixie-security rebuilds, which must not wait out an age gate (and the vulnerabilityAlerts fast path can't help - that only covers GitHub's advisory DB, which has no deb coverage and is inert on the Forgejo platform anyway; osvVulnerabilityAlerts likewise has no deb coverage); and madison supplies no releaseTimestamps, which under internalChecksFilter=strict would silently freeze apt bumps forever rather than delay them.
Standalone bumps for tool versions tracked in build.yml (crane, etc.).

Major bumps require manual review — surface as checkboxes on the Dependency Dashboard, do not open the PR automatically, do not auto-merge. Minor/patch still flow through automerge gated by all-ci (which must be a required status check in the Forgejo branch protection for platformAutomerge to wait on it).

Keep workflow actions on floating major tags (@vN). Suppress pin/patch/minor so they are never pinned to an exact patch (upstream moves the @vN tag, so patch fixes land at runtime without a PR); a new MAJOR still surfaces via the rule above. Applies to both the Forgejo workflows and any remaining GitHub workflow copy.

debian-madison.description: Debian QA madison (UDD-backed): one `pkg | version | suite | archs` text line per suite. Only sees what apt in the trixie image can install (trixie, trixie-updates, trixie-security). Replaces the built-in deb datasource, which cannot read debian-security (Packages.xz only).
